parameters.name: IsPublish
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to publish the version directly after the rollback.
- **true** (default): Publish and roll back.
- **false**: Only roll back without publishing.

parameters.name: PlayReleaseId
parameters.description:
The ID of the playbook release version.
>You can call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.
>You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
